notes.title: Development Update September 2024
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

It has been a while and I wanted to give an update of how Extraktion 1943 is developing. 

We're making slow but steady progress on this. (You may have noticed we have a bunch of other games that require our attention). We've got the multiplayer feature running smoothly in our initial tests and continue to work on some of the core functionality of the game (currently the inventory system).

Anyway I just wanted to let you all know the game is still in development (albeit part time). 

When can we expect a fist playable version? I don't want to make any promises but hopefully in 2025.

You can [url=https://chuteapps.com/extraktion-1943-beta/]Sign Up For Our Beta[/url] to get first access when it's ready.

-Carl Chute

notes.title: Major Update! Completely Reworked Style!
notes.content:
After long deliberation, we decided that it would be really hard to do Extraktion 1943 justice with the classic pixel art style. SO, after many months of work, here is a sneak peak at our new style.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2631080/extras/g1.gif?t=1703364938[/img]

We hope you like it :) You can also see the updated Trailer on the steam page.

If you haven't already, sign up for our private Beta we'll be running in a few months. It will be the first playable version of Extraktion 1943 and I'd love if you were a part of the process. 

[url=https://chuteapps.com/extraktion-1943-beta/]SIGN UP FOR BETA[/url]

-Carl
